base_member_text: Cross-line index bug: in the Not_done_periodic block the loop runs DO KK=1,NumFreq (L444) but assigns Theta_2D(I,KKK) (L448 and L450) using I - I is a module/global integer left at NumFreq+1 by the earlier DO I=1,NumFreq loop (L422), so only one row of Theta_2D is written while the Cm/Sm superposition reads Theta_2D(KK,KKK) (L497-526)
audit_member_text: The direction initialization loops over frequency index KK and direction index KKK (L444-L453) but writes Theta_2D(I,KKK), not Theta_2D(KK,KKK), in both branches (L448, L450). I is a host-associated/global loop variable rather than the active frequency index, so one row may be repeatedly overwritten or the write may be out of bounds, while reconstruction later reads Theta_2D(KK,KKK) for every KK (L497-L526).

audit_member_text: Initialization allocates AmpData1 but reads only AmpData2 and copies the time/name, not the amplitude matrix (L176-L181, L243-L264). In interpolation tmp1 and tmp2 start at zero and remain zero when TIME is equal to or earlier than the first timestamp (L362-L375); L377 then multiplies the uninitialized AmpData1 by zero and also zeroes AmpData2, yielding zero or undefined Amp_Ser at that boundary.

At schedule EOF the routine first advances TimeSpectra1 and AmpData1 to the last loaded record (L325-L329), then an EOF on the next time read jumps directly to label 120 (L333-L335, L379), bypassing L361-L377. Amp_Ser therefore remains the previous pre-EOF interpolation rather than being explicitly set to the final AmpData1, and subsequent calls repeat the same EOF jump.
